ticket_id = doc.custom_service_ticket

if ticket_id:
    try:
        ticket = frappe.get_doc("Service Ticket", ticket_id)

        # Always update commercial status when quotation is submitted
        ticket.custom_commercial_status = "Quote Sent"
        ticket.custom_requires_parts = doc.custom_requires_parts or 0

        # Only pause technical ticket if work is not already done
        if ticket.custom_ticket_status not in ["Resolved", "Closed"]:
            ticket.custom_ticket_status = "On Hold"
            ticket.custom_hold_reason = "Awaiting Quote Approval"

        exists = False

        for row in ticket.get("custom_commercial_references") or []:
            if row.custom_reference_type == "Quotation" and row.custom_reference_name == doc.name:
                exists = True
                row.custom_status = doc.status
                row.custom_amount = doc.grand_total or 0
                row.custom_posting_date = doc.transaction_date
                row.custom_remarks = "Quotation submitted"

        if not exists:
            ticket.append("custom_commercial_references", {
                "custom_reference_type": "Quotation",
                "custom_reference_name": doc.name,
                "custom_status": doc.status,
                "custom_amount": doc.grand_total or 0,
                "custom_posting_date": doc.transaction_date,
                "custom_remarks": "Quotation submitted"
            })

        ticket.save(ignore_permissions=True)

    except Exception as e:
        frappe.log_error(str(e), "Quotation Service Ticket Sync Failed")
